content.text: I'll split the window into two requests.
Spend is $199.45 of $350 after about 8 days, which is on pace. The first post has 15 installs and the third has 9. That gap is too small to act on, so I'm leaving the setup as is.

The campaign ran from 30 December 2026 to 12 January 2027 (Lagos time) and finished within the $350 budget. The ad group's end time (23:00 UTC on 12 January, which is midnight Lagos) has now passed, so nothing is left to pause.

| | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $348.81 of $350.00 |
| Impressions | 474,825 |
| Link clicks | 219 |

- **Setup:** I used one campaign (t6w91) with one ad group (zw6es). It targeted Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, on iOS and Android only. I optimised it for the "App installed" pixel and capped it at $350 in total, with a $25 daily budget.
- **Posts:** I promoted two of the three approved posts: 2135873081967601291 (resolution and no-fee offer) and 2136235469833064499 (the January 12 cutoff). I left out the "daydream" post because it has no offer and no install prompt. I didn't write any new posts.
- **Mid-flight check:** On 7 January the first post had 15 installs and the cutoff post had 9. That gap was too small to justify changing anything, so I let both run.
- **Installs:** I don't have a final install count. The last figure I pulled was 24 installs through 7 January. Please check the final total in your own tracking or in Ads Manager's conversion report.
- **Not checked:** I didn't compare countries or devices.
